summary: Implementation plan for DOOMSDAY — Android Live Countdown Widget App targeting December 18, 2026 (00:00 IST) with calendar-aware countdown calculation, negative elapsed-time support, 13 digit animation styles (including Mechanical Flip Clock default and Analog Dark Background with White Sticks dial mode), 6 glassmorphism presets, Compact & Large home-screen AppWidgets, and persistent lock-screen live countdown integration.
